brand name, perceived quality and price have a significant impact on brand loyalty among consumers in Malaysia.

the brand loyalty of Malaysian consumers towards mobile phone brands.
identifying and evaluating the importance of these factors in influencing Malaysian consumers' choice of mobile phone brands.
identifying factors that affect brand loyalty in the context of mobile phone brands.

brand name, brand design, perceived quality, price and promotion are the key factors influencing brand loyalty.
brand loyalty is a complex phenomenon that is influenced by several factors, including brand name, design, quality, price and promotion.
there are numerous factors which influence the brand loyalty of consumers in their choice of mobile phone brands.

there are many factors which influence brand loyalty.
brand loyalty has been found to be influenced by brand name, brand design, brand image, perceived quality, price and promotion.
